acceptance_dimensions.silhouette_exterior_identity: PolyCore magenta emergency-dispatch bands and a white logistics crown turn the corporate warehouse into a late-containment substitution center
acceptance_dimensions.interior_zoning_circulation: mixed material intake lanes feed five substitution stock rows, a field-kit packing area and a marked emergency dispatch court while the office wing remains the request-and-records node
acceptance_dimensions.functional_machinery_props: polymer remnants, ceramic stock, steel sheets, emergency crates and cardboard field kits show a center assembling replacement packages for many industries at once
acceptance_dimensions.institutional_identity: PolyCore magenta/white routing lanes and repeated mixed-material bays present an organized cross-industry continuity program rather than ordinary warehousing
acceptance_dimensions.historical_damage_signature: the old polymer lane is increasingly isolated while ceramic and metal stocks dominate the later rows and the outbound court is choked with staged emergency kits
acceptance_dimensions.narrative_evidence_loot: guaranteed emergency substitution directive documents the attempt to keep utilities, hospitals and industry operating by replacing failing material classes faster than they degraded
